files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The top of a post page: category, title, excerpt, the author line and an optional wide cover. Axes: layout
  (start, center), cover (show, hide), meta (full, short), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";

  export type PostHeaderProps = {
    id: string;
    post?: Post;
    labels: PostLabels;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    layout?: "start" | "center";
    cover?: "show" | "hide";
    meta?: "full" | "short";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Pill from "../components/pill.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    post,
    labels,
    level = 1,
    layout = "start",
    cover = "show",
    meta = "full",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PostHeaderProps = $props();
</script>

{#if post}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={post?.title}
    lead={post?.excerpt}
    heading={{ level }}
    align={layout}
    tone={tone}
    media={{ show: ((cover as string) === "show") }}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <Group
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      justify={(((layout as string) === "center") ? "center" : "start")}
      class="flex-wrap"
      data-testid="post-meta"
    >
      <MediaFrame alt={post?.author} ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
        {post?.author}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {post?.date}
      </Text>
      {#if ((meta as string) === "full")}
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl(labels.minutes, post?.minutes)}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      <Pill tone="blue">
        {post?.category}
      </Pill>
    </Group>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame alt={post?.title} src={post?.image} ratio="21/9" />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame id={id} heading={{ level }} align={layout} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
    <EmptyState icon="file-text" title={labels.empty} />
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
